notes.title: Release Patch 1
notes.content:
- Performance improvements for levels with a lot of foliage
- Added a loading spinner when it takes longer than half a second to enter a level

tags.feature: - Added a loading spinner when it takes longer than half a second to enter a level

notes.title: Secrets!
notes.content: [list][*][p]Secret collectables have been added to Mirrormind. These unlock additional appendix levels at the end of the game. These appendix levels showcase mechanics and puzzles that were not as fully explored and were cut for various reasons.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug for Windows users where cloud saving wouldn't transfer save files correctly. This should not affect your save file, it just means it'll now be backed up via Steam Cloud saves.[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked the order of puzzle unlocks. Rather than being linear, players can now tackle puzzles in a different order if they get stumped. The last puzzle of a world requires completing all puzzles in that world still.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a minor bug with button icons not matching the controller when a Playstation controller was used.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor miscellaneous level changes to allow for secrets.[/p][/*][/list][p]As always, let me know if you encounter any issues.[/p][p]Cheers[/p]

tags.feature: Secret collectables have been added to Mirrormind. These unlock additional appendix levels at the end of the game. These appendix levels showcase mechanics and puzzles that were not as fully explored and were cut for various reasons.

tags.bug: Fixed a bug for Windows users where cloud saving wouldn't transfer save files correctly. This should not affect your save file, it just means it'll now be backed up via Steam Cloud saves.

tags.balance_change: Tweaked the order of puzzle unlocks. Rather than being linear, players can now tackle puzzles in a different order if they get stumped. The last puzzle of a world requires completing all puzzles in that world still.

tags.bug: Fixed a minor bug with button icons not matching the controller when a Playstation controller was used.

tags.balance_change: Minor miscellaneous level changes to allow for secrets.
